# 02 — Session intake and managed Mission workspace

## Outcome

Add a Session-owned immutable submitted-input reference and a Mission-owned
create/locate managed workspace path, so a new planning request starts without
manual transcript-folder scaffolding.

## Non-goal

Do not mutate a finished Session or migrate old Mission/dossier archives.
The implemented future workflow must create a planning Mission before
execution approval; that is the purpose of this waypoint. This planning
dossier itself creates no Mission.

## Inputs and implementation boundary

Build on W1 and [Session capture/runtime sources](ARTIFACTS.md#relevant-existing-artifacts).
Missing input and finished-session behavior use the proposed structured errors;
unavailable workspace is a failure, never an empty result.

The Session owns append-only submitted-input bytes and their digest; Mission
stores a canonical input reference and immutable copy with source identity,
not a replacement Session transcript. Repeated intake with the same request
ID and bytes returns the same Mission; a reused ID with different bytes is
a conflict. Creation returns Mission ID, revision, explicit owning root,
managed directory, canonical input and generated-plan entry paths.

Use the existing UUID Mission directory, not another transcript-folder tree.
Source material and generated projections have separate tool-owned paths.
Reject traversal/symlink escapes and incompatible stores. Journal the
Session/Mission linkage so interrupted creation can resume without duplicate
Missions or a success-shaped partial result. Discovery must distinguish a
missing Mission from an unavailable store.

## Expected post-state and validation

An empty temporary Session/Mission store flow can persist intake, create one
managed Mission workspace, return the same location on lookup, and preserve
the relation over restart/replay without shell-created folders.

Future targets: `cd workflow-tools && cargo test -p session-api -p mission`;
an integration test must assert no-folder bootstrap, restart replay, and
non-silent `intake_missing`/`session_finished` failures.

## Checkpoint

Commit Session/Mission integration and its isolated-store tests after passing.
